In a video above I take a look at the bias (bullish or bearish), the risks, the targets for each and show and explain why.

data.title: Fed’s Musalem: Moving sooner with rate hikes lessens risk of hit to broader economy
data.description:
Comments from the Fed’s Musalem cross the wires:

  • Moving sooner with rate hikes lessens risk of hit to broader economy.
  • US central bank will need to raise interest rates again “soon.”
  • Incremental changes in rates better than abrupt changes.
  • Higher long-term bond yields driven by expected higher policy rates.
  • Inflation still too high, unlikely to ease without Fed actions.
  • Monetary policy is accommodative right now.
  • Overall financial conditions remain accommodative.
  • Best thing Fed can do now is restore price stability.
  • Financial conditions tighter but not by much.
  • Broader economy and job market strong.
  • Risks still skewed toward higher inflation.
  • Inflation expectations have been anchored.

data.title: Fed’s Daly: AI matters for near- and medium-term policy
data.description:

  • AI matters to price stability and employment mandates.

data.title: Fitch on UK Budget: Policy continuity leaves a tough delivery challenge
data.description:
Fitch’s assessment of the UK Budget points to a familiar problem: setting out a path to stronger public finances is one thing. Delivering it is another.

The ratings agency sees broad continuity in government policy, but warns that the plans still leave a sizeable delivery challenge. It continues to anticipate significant slippage against spending plans and says fiscal consolidation becomes much more challenging to deliver from 2027.

data.title: Gold tumbles despite lower yields. Technicals show the way.
data.description:
Gold is moving sharply lower despite a decline in US Treasury yields. The 10-year yield is down 5 basis points to 4.939%, a move that would normally provide some support for the precious metal. Instead, gold is trading near $3900, down roughly $120, or 3%, after reaching a session low near $3891.

That divergence is telling. Buyers have a potentially supportive move in the bond market, but they are struggling to turn it into buying momentum. When the price cannot rally on a favorable development, traders need to respect what the price action is saying.

data.title: Nasdaq leads stocks lower as investors question the cost of AI growth
data.description: US stocks are trading lower, with the Nasdaq indices taking the biggest hit as investors reassess the earnings outlook—and the cost of delivering on the AI growth story.

data.title: Fed's Barkin: Direction of travel is straightforward for the Fed
data.description:
Comments from the Fed’s Barkin cross the wires:

  • Direction of travel is “straightforward” for the Fed, the question is pace.
  • A gradual approach is a good way to go right now.
  • A lot of cost pressures are hitting American businesses.
  • In the context of years of elevated inflation it is easier for businesses to argue they need to raise prices.
  • Resilience of consumer spending has been a surprise given relatively flat incomes.
  • The AI investment surge has pressured supply chains, and that is inflationary.
  • AI investment is leading to demand side inflation, which is the kind of thing the Fed can lean against.
  • Businesses are saying that there cost pressures are broad-based.
  • Businesses are laying plans to pass those costs on to their customers.

data.title: IC Launches New Guillermo Ochoa Campaign Focused on Performance Under Pressure
data.description:
IC, a global provider of online trading services, has launched a new campaign featuring Mexican football goalkeeper Guillermo Ochoa, building on its partnership with the player and continued brand activity across Latin America.

The campaign draws on Ochoa's experience in international football, where years of preparation can come down to a single decision. It highlights the importance of reading changing conditions, responding with precision and remaining focused under pressure.

data.title: Bitcoin sellers jump on the risk-off bandwagon
data.description: With US and European stocks moving lower, bitcoin is following the risk-off sentiment. However, the move also has a technical catalyst: a break below the consolidation range that had contained the price since October 22.

data.title: Crude oil extends gains as traders hedge into weekend amid risks of US strikes on Iran
data.description:
Crude oil extended the gains into new highs yesterday after the Houthis targeted the Aramco oil company in widespread wave of missile attacks.

The bullish momentum then accelerated after the Wall Street Journal reported that in a rare in-person visit to the White House, the top US commander in the Middle East briefed Trump on military options for Iran as the US weighed resuming major combat operations.

data.title: Morning Kickstart: Tech hammered as Amazon and Intel tumble; oil rises despite peace talk
data.description:
Technology stocks are taking another hit heading into Friday’s North American session. Disappointing earnings from Amazon and a sharp negative reaction to Intel’s results are adding to concerns about the spending, profitability and expectations surrounding the AI trade.

The weakness is concentrated in technology, with Nasdaq futures down 785 points and S&P futures down 84 points, while Dow futures are holding a modest 15-point gain. That divergence matters. Technology is leading the pressure, while the Dow is showing greater resilience.

data.title: Ethereum tumbles as Binance hack triggers risk-off wave across crypto markets. What's next?
data.description:
Ethereum tanked yesterday following the news of Binance security breach, which reportedly resulted in approximately $6.3 billion being drained from wallets across multiple blockchains. It was the largest cryptocurrency heist in history.

The hack raised concerns about exchange security and potential contagion across the crypto ecosystem. Although Binance pledged to cover customer losses, uncertainty surrounding the stolen assets and potential liquidations weighed on sentiment.
